events.body:
For Supabase Auth, the decision starts with coverage. Loops is an email sending platform that can take over Auth email through either SMTP or the Send Email Hook.

SMTP covers confirm signup, magic link, invite, change email and reset password. The hook covers all Send Email Hook action types, including security notifications.

Both routes use Loops transactional emails and require configured templates and a verified Loops sending domain. The hook also uses a Supabase Edge Function, with one Loops template for each Auth type you configure.

Changing the sending route does not address Supabase’s separate Auth email rate-limit setting. Treat that as a separate Supabase configuration decision.

Loops’ Supabase docs compare the two routes, their supported email types and their setup, so you can choose based on the coverage your app requires.

events.subject: Compare Supabase Auth sending routes
events.preview_text: Choose between SMTP and the Send Email Hook by coverage and setup.
events.body:
Start with the Auth messages your app needs to send. Loops is an email sending platform that can send Supabase Auth email through SMTP or the Send Email Hook.

SMTP covers confirm signup, magic link, invite, change email and reset password. If you also need other Send Email Hook action types, including security notifications, use the hook route.

The hook requires a Supabase Edge Function and one Loops template for each Auth type you configure. Either route also requires a verified Loops sending domain before Loops can send the email.

Loops’ Supabase documentation shows both supported routes, compares their coverage and walks through their setup. Use it to match the required components and Auth email types to your app.
